title_en: Cai Yulong v. Nanjing Jinzhongjian Curtain Wall Decoration Co., Ltd. — dispute over labor contract
ruling_gist_en: Employers shall, in accordance with the Labor Contract Law, issue a certificate of dissolution or termination of the labor contract when dissolving or terminating the labor contract, handle the transfer of personnel files and social insurance relations for the worker within fifteen days, and complete the transfer procedures for professional certificates within a reasonable period. If the employer fails to handle the above matters promptly, thereby causing the worker to be unable to complete relevant onboarding procedures when seeking re-employment or unable to produce relevant certificates, which seriously affects the new employer's assessment of the worker's work attitude and professional competence, leading to the worker's inability to obtain employment smoothly and harming the worker's right to re-employment, the employer shall compensate the worker for the loss of employment.
keywords_en: Civil; Labor contract dispute; First instance; Basic People's Court; Jiangsu Province; Natural person; Legal person; Labor Contract Law; Liability for compensation for failure to timely handle resignation procedures; Obligation to return professional certificates; Calculation standard for loss of employment; Partial support; Dissolution of labor contract; Seizure of professional certificates; Obstruction of re-employment; Contract dispute; Labor contract; Social insurance; Decoration Co., Ltd. labor contract dispute
full_text_en:
Cai Yulong v. Nanjing Jinzhongjian Curtain Wall Decoration Co., Ltd.

— dispute over labor contract

【Ruling Summary】

An employer shall, in accordance with the provisions of the Labor Contract Law, issue a certificate of dissolution or termination of the labor contract at the time of dissolution or termination, complete the transfer procedures for the employee's personnel file and social insurance relationship within fifteen days, and complete the transfer procedures for the employee's professional certificates within a reasonable period. If the employer fails to timely complete the above matters, resulting in the employee being unable to complete relevant onboarding procedures or present relevant certificates when seeking re-employment, which seriously affects the new employer's assessment of the employee's work attitude and professional competence, thereby preventing the employee from obtaining smooth re-employment and damaging the employee's right to re-employment, the employer shall compensate the employee for the loss of employment.

Plaintiff: Cai Yulong, male, 43 years old, Han ethnicity, residing in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Nanjing Jinzhongjian Curtain Wall Decoration Co., Ltd., domiciled at Shuanglong Avenue, Jiangning Economic and Technological Development Zone, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Cui Kairong, Chairman of the Company.

The plaintiff, Cai Yulong, filed a lawsuit with the Jiangning District People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, against the defendant, Nanjing Jinzhongjian Curtain Wall Decoration Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jinzhongjian Company), concerning a labor contract dispute.

The plaintiff, Cai Yulong, alleged that after joining the defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, he submitted, as required by the company, his Level 1 Construction Engineer Practice Certificate and Registration Certificate and seal, National Registered Safety Engineer Practice Certificate and Registration Certificate, Safety B Certificate, Senior Engineer Certificate, etc. After leaving Jinzhongjian Company, because the company failed to return the above certificates in time, failed to issue a resignation certificate in time, and failed to handle resignation procedures such as the transfer of the construction engineer qualification, social insurance, and housing provident fund in time, he was unable to obtain re-employment. He now petitions the court, requesting a judgment: 1. That Jinzhongjian Company return his Level 1 Construction Engineer Practice Certificate and Registration Certificate and seal, National Registered Safety Engineer Practice Certificate and Registration Certificate, Safety B Certificate, Senior Engineer Certificate, etc.; that Jinzhongjian Company issue a resignation certificate and assist in handling resignation procedures such as the transfer of the construction engineer qualification, social insurance, and housing provident fund; 2. That Jinzhongjian Company compensate him for losses of RMB 82,500 due to the delay in returning the certificates and failure to handle resignation procedures, which prevented him from re-employment (calculated at the standard of RMB 15,000/month from May 13, 2015 to October 28, 2015).

The defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, argued that the plaintiff, Cai Yulong, voluntarily applied for resignation from its company, and that it did not detain Cai Yulong's Construction Engineer Practice Certificate and Registration Certificate. Cai Yulong's request for compensation for losses should not be upheld, and the court should reject Cai Yulong's claims.

The Jiangning District People's Court of Nanjing found at the first instance:

The plaintiff, Cai Yulong, joined the defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, on February 24, 2014. On the same day, the parties signed a labor contract with a term from February 24, 2014 to February 23, 2019. On January 20, 2015, Jinzhongjian Company, in accordance with relevant industry regulations, temporarily deposited Cai Yulong's Level 1 Construction Engineer Certificate with the Nanjing Decoration Industry Management Office. On March 28, 2015, Cai Yulong submitted a written resignation application to Jinzhongjian Company "due to the need for personal career development opportunities." On April 28, 2015, the parties signed an agreement to dissolve the labor relationship. In the 12 months before resignation, Cai Yulong's average monthly salary was RMB 13,975.

The plaintiff, Cai Yulong, claimed that he had submitted his personnel file, employment certificate, Level 1 Construction Engineer Certificate and seal, Level 1 Construction Engineer Registration Certificate, Senior Engineer Certificate, Registered Safety Engineer Certificate and Qualification Certificate, and Safety B Certificate to the defendant, Jinzhongjian Company. He submitted: 1. Two receipts, which stated that on February 15, 2014 and May 29, 2014 respectively, Cai Yulong handed over his personnel file, employment certificate, Level 1 Construction Engineer Certificate, Level 1 Construction Engineer Registration Certificate, Senior Engineer Certificate, and Registered Safety Engineer Practice Certificate and Qualification Certificate to Wang Fang and Zhang Lili of the Human Resources Department of Jinzhongjian Company; 2. A copy of the resignation work handover form, in which Cai Yulong stated in court that the Level 1 Construction Engineer seal was handed over to Jinzhongjian Company after the receipt was issued, and the Safety B Certificate was obtained through examination while at Jinzhongjian Company. On May 7, 2015, he handed over the Safety B Certificate to Chen Ping.

On November 30, 2015, the defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, returned the plaintiff, Cai Yulong's Senior Engineer Certificate (professional title certificate), Level 1 Construction Engineer Practice Certificate, Level 1 Construction Engineer Registration Certificate, Registered Safety Engineer Practice Qualification Certificate, and Registered Safety Engineer Practice Certificate in court, but did not acknowledge that Cai Yulong had entrusted the Safety B Certificate and Level 1 Construction Engineer seal to its custody.

Regarding whether the defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, delayed returning certificates and failed to handle the plaintiff, Cai Yulong's resignation procedures, causing Cai Yulong to be unable to find employment smoothly, Cai Yulong stated that he had not found a job because all prospective employers required him to provide job-related certificates. For example, Nanjing Beilida New Materials Co., Ltd. required him to provide the Level 1 Construction Engineer Certificate, resignation certificate, social insurance transfer procedures, etc. Jinzhongjian Company argued that Cai Yulong voluntarily resigned and had been employed by another entity after resignation, and therefore should not be compensated for alleged inability to find a job. It submitted the minutes and sign-in sheet of the "Expert Demonstration Meeting for the External Façade Renovation Project of the Sun Palace Renovation and Surrounding Environment Comprehensive Improvement Project" to prove that Cai Yulong attended the meeting on behalf of Jiangsu Tianmao Construction Engineering Co., Ltd. and was already employed by that company at that time. Cai Yulong did not dispute the authenticity of the evidence, but stated that he signed in on the sign-in sheet under the name of his previous employer before joining Jinzhongjian Company, "Beijing Jiayu," and that in August 2015, he was invited by Jiangsu Tianmao Construction Engineering Co., Ltd. to attend the expert demonstration meeting. He also submitted a certificate from Jiangsu Tianmao Construction Engineering Co., Ltd., stating that Cai Yulong did not have a labor contract or employment relationship with that company.

During the trial, the defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, applied for a court investigation order to the Nanjing Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security and the Nanjing Jiangning Local Taxation Bureau to investigate the plaintiff, Cai Yulong's employment situation after May 2015, but did not submit the results of the investigation. Following the application by Jinzhongjian Company, the court lawfully obtained Cai Yulong's individual income tax payment certificate for the period after May 2015, which showed that Cai Yulong had no record of individual income tax payment in Nanjing from May to November 2015.

The Jiangning District People's Court of Nanjing held at the first instance:

Regarding the plaintiff, Cai Yulong's claim for the return of certificates, the receipts and the copy of the resignation personnel handover checklist submitted by Cai Yulong were insufficient to prove that he had entrusted the Safety B Certificate and Level 1 Construction Engineer seal to the defendant, Jinzhongjian Company for custody. Therefore, the court did not support his request for Jinzhongjian Company to deliver the above two items. As for the other certificates claimed by Cai Yulong, Jinzhongjian Company had already returned them in court, and this was confirmed.

Regarding the plaintiff, Cai Yulong's claim for resignation procedures. An employer shall, in accordance with the provisions of the Labor Contract Law, issue a certificate of dissolution or termination of the labor contract at the time of dissolution or termination, and complete the transfer procedures for the employee's personnel file and social insurance relationship within fifteen days. The employer shall also complete the transfer procedures for the certificates related to the employee's job position to facilitate the employee's re-employment. In this case, the labor relationship between the plaintiff and the defendant was dissolved on April 28, 2015. The defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, should, in accordance with legal provisions and the contract, handle the above procedures for Cai Yulong. Therefore, the court supported Cai Yulong's claim for Jinzhongjian Company to issue a resignation certificate and assist in handling resignation procedures such as the transfer of the construction engineer qualification, social insurance, and housing provident fund.

Regarding the plaintiff, Cai Yulong's claim that the defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, should compensate him for losses due to unemployment. If an employer fails to timely handle resignation procedures for the employee, fails to issue a written certificate of dissolution or termination of the labor contract to the employee, resulting in the employee being unable to complete relevant onboarding procedures or present relevant certificates when seeking re-employment, thereby preventing smooth re-employment and damaging the employee's right to re-employment, the employer shall provide compensation in accordance with legal provisions. In this case, after the labor relationship between the plaintiff and the defendant was dissolved on April 28, 2015, Jinzhongjian Company failed to handle the resignation procedures for Cai Yulong within the statutory time limit. On the one hand, the Labor Contract Law stipulates that if an employer hires a worker whose labor contract with another employer has not been dissolved or terminated, and causes damage to the other employer, the hiring employer shall bear joint and several liability. Therefore, when hiring workers, employers usually require workers to provide resignation certificates, personnel files, social insurance transfer procedures, etc. Due to Jinzhongjian Company's delay, Cai Yulong was unable to present these documents to new employers, which may have affected his re-employment. On the other hand, since the construction industry-related certificates obtained by Cai Yulong were necessary conditions for his re-employment, and the labor relationship was dissolved on April 28, 2015, but Jinzhongjian Company did not return the relevant certificates until November 30, 2015, and the transfer procedures for the certificates have still not been completed, far exceeding a reasonable period, Cai Yulong was unable to present these to new employers before the certificates were returned and the transfer procedures were completed. This seriously affected the new employers' assessment of his professional competence and inevitably impacted his re-employment. In summary, Jinzhongjian Company's failure to timely handle Cai Yulong's resignation procedures has already affected Cai Yulong's right to re-employment and should provide compensation to Cai Yulong. Regarding the standard of compensation, the plaintiff, Cai Yulong's salary standard at the defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, was a true reflection of his work ability and performance, and it is objective and reasonable to calculate the loss based on this salary. Therefore, the compensation standard was set as Cai Yulong's average monthly salary in the 12 months before resignation from Jinzhongjian Company, i.e., RMB 13,975, and the calculation period was determined to be 4 months.

Accordingly, the Jiangning District People's Court of Nanjing, in accordance with Articles 50 and 89 of the Labor Contract Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 64 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the judgment on December 9, 2015:

1. The defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, shall pay the plaintiff, Cai Yulong, compensation of RMB 55,900 for losses caused by the failure to handle resignation procedures.

2. The defendant, Jinzhongjian Company, shall, within 15 days from the effective date of this judgment, assist the plaintiff, Cai Yulong, in issuing a resignation certificate, handling the transfer procedures for the construction engineer qualification, social insurance, and housing provident fund, and other resignation procedures. After the first instance judgment was pronounced, both Cai Yulong and Jinzhongjian Company refused to accept it and filed appeals with the Intermediate People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.

The appellant, Cai Yulong, appealed: 1. Jinzhongjian Company should pay Cai Yulong compensation for lost work of RMB 83,850 for the period from May 13, 2015 to December 19, 2015, totaling 6 months. The first instance court's determination that Jinzhongjian Company should pay 4 months' compensation was inconsistent with the facts; 2. Jinzhongjian Company has still not returned the Safety B Certificate and the Level 1 Construction Engineer seal obtained through examination while at the company. The Qilin Technology Innovation Park work handover registration form submitted by Cai Yulong in the first instance can prove that the Safety B Certificate and Level 1 Construction Engineer certificate were handed over to Chen Ping, a clerk of Jinzhongjian Company, for custody when handling the resignation procedures. After Chen Ping signed, this form was taken back by the Human Resources Department. Since Jinzhongjian Company returned the Level 1 Construction Engineer certificate in the first instance, it indicates that the Safety B Certificate is also in Jinzhongjian Company's possession. Since Jinzhongjian Company failed to provide the original of the Qilin Technology Innovation Park work handover registration form, it should bear the adverse consequences. In summary, he requested the second instance court to set aside the first instance judgment and render a new judgment in accordance with law.

Jinzhongjian Company argued: 1. Regarding the 6 months' lost work compensation of RMB 83,850 caused by the detained certificates, the appellant, Cai Yulong, suddenly submitted his resignation. According to industry practice, as the construction projects under Cai Yulong's responsibility were not completed, the certificates had to be deposited with the industry association. Jinzhongjian Company only obtained the certificates after coordination until November 30, 2015, the date of the first instance trial. The detention of the certificates was not due to Jinzhongjian Company's fault. Jinzhongjian Company had already prepared the social insurance relationship transfer form and placed it in the personnel file, which is kept at the Nanjing Talent Market. 2. Regarding the Level 1 Construction Engineer seal and Safety B Certificate, Jinzhongjian Company had returned all certificates for which there were receipts to Cai Yulong. There were no receipts for the Safety B Certificate and the seal, and Cai Yulong could not prove they were in Jinzhongjian Company's possession.

The appellant, Jinzhongjian Company, appealed: The appellant, Cai Yulong, was the project manager for the curtain wall project of Buildings 5 and 6, Area A, Phase I Start-up Area of the Zijin (Qilin) Technology Entrepreneurship Community. Jinzhongjian Company, as required, filed his Level 1 Construction Engineer Practice Certificate and Registration Certificate with the Nanjing Construction Engineering Bureau and deposited them with the Nanjing Decoration Management Office for safekeeping. Cai Yulong suddenly submitted his resignation, and Jinzhongjian Company needed to negotiate with the project owner and handle the procedures for changing the person in charge of the project. At the end of April 2015, Jinzhongjian Company completed the work handover procedures with Cai Yulong, issued a certificate of dissolution of the labor contract, and stopped the procedures for paying social insurance and housing provident fund. On May 21, 2015, when Cai Yulong applied for labor arbitration, the approval for changing the person in charge of the project was still in progress. The certificates were kept by the industry association, and Jinzhongjian Company did not detain them. After leaving Jinzhongjian Company, Cai Yulong worked on behalf of other companies. The first instance's finding that Cai Yulong had not regained employment was inconsistent with the facts. The first instance court's determination that Jinzhongjian Company should pay compensation for lost work to Cai Yulong had no factual basis. In summary, he requested the second instance court to amend the judgment so that Jinzhongjian Company would not pay Cai Yulong compensation of RMB 55,900 for losses caused by failure to handle resignation procedures.

Cai Yulong argued: Cai Yulong submitted his resignation to Jinzhongjian Company on March 28, 2015, and obtained leadership approval and completed the handover procedures by April 28. This was a resignation with 30 days' advance notice, not a sudden resignation. Jinzhongjian Company persistently failed to issue a dismissal certificate and social insurance relationship transfer procedures, and detained various certificates and seals, preventing Cai Yulong from joining a new employer. Subsequently, when Cai Yulong applied to other entities, they also required certificates and seals for onboarding. Currently, Jinzhongjian Company still has not issued a dismissal certificate or social insurance transfer certificate. Jinzhongjian Company has not returned the Safety B Certificate and the Level 1 Construction Engineer seal. Upon investigation, the Safety B Certificate is still in Jinzhongjian Company's possession and has not been cancelled. Jinzhongjian Company claimed that the industry association kept these certificates, but the industry association only kept one of the certificates, while the rest were held by Jinzhongjian Company. Therefore, Jinzhongjian Company's grounds for appeal were not established.

The Intermediate People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, upon second instance trial, confirmed the facts found in the first instance.

The Intermediate People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, held at the second instance:

Regarding the appellant Cai Yulong's claim for the return of the Safety B Certificate and Level 1 Construction Engineer seal. Since Cai Yulong did not provide evidence proving that he had submitted the Safety B Certificate and Level 1 Construction Engineer seal to the appellant Jinzhongjian Company, this appellate claim was not supported. Regarding the loss caused by the failure to return certificates in a timely manner. The appellant Cai Yulong left his job on April 28, 2015. The appellant Jinzhongjian Company should have actively handled the transfer procedures for the relevant certificates within a reasonable period. However, Jinzhongjian Company did not return the relevant certificates to Cai Yulong until November 30, 2015, exceeding a reasonable period. The first instance's decision to calculate compensation for Cai Yulong's loss of 4 months' salary based on his average monthly salary of RMB 13,975 before resignation was not inappropriate. Therefore, both Cai Yulong's claim for 6 months' salary loss and Jinzhongjian Company's objection to paying salary loss for this period were not supported.

In conclusion, the facts found in the first instance judgment were clear, and the handling was not inappropriate. The Intermediate People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, in accordance with Article 170, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment on April 14, 2016:

The appeal is dismissed, and the original judgment is affirmed.

This judgment is final.
